timingContract.apiEntryToAckArrivalMs: Socket only: Viewer API entry to prependAny before original ACK handlers; DC raw arrival remains null/unknown; not enqueue RTT
timingContract.ackSynchronousHandlerMs: prependAny arrival through added socket.on listener after original product handlers; includes all preceding synchronous listeners
timingContract.m1InputAckRttMs: Unchanged M1 metric sampled after original handler; M1 takes its clock after Input/UI processing
timingContract.inputAckArrivalRttMs: Product ACK-handler entry clock minus pending send, recorded only after C validation and pending correlation; not native wire arrival
timingContract.inputAckValidationMs: Product processing clock minus its captured ACK entry clock; original M1 clock is unchanged
timingContract.metricOwnership: M1: unique acked+1 and real pending consumption prove its push. New arrival/validation metrics additionally require their own rolling count +1. All require age<=20ms; missing/expired/unproven values remain null
timingContract.signalRequestToAckMs: Signal local monotonic post-Host-emit registration through matching Host ACK handler; includes Host processing and local transport
timingContract.forbidden: No cross-clock subtraction, p95 addition/subtraction, replay, business input or forced reset route; missing stages null
